# Whether flowing water and flowing lava go into every block state, as both official servers decide it (harness 0.22.0
# flow report): each state set with updates on dirt in a cell of its own, a source set beside it two ticks later, and
# the cell read 10 ticks (water) or 40 ticks (lava) later. Codes: water then lava, 1 when the fluid took the cell, 0
# when not; - when the report cannot tell (the state did not stay until the fluid came, the same updates without a fluid
# changed it, or it is a fluid). Each block's rows give only the properties that decide them.
# Java Edition 1.21.8: every state.
